concepts.definition: Gender pay gap in average (mean) base salary for the reporting employer's workforce, expressed as a decimal fraction of men's average base salary (0.244 = 24.4%); negative values indicate a gap favouring women. Scoped to the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year and to the employer reporting unit, not the corporate group.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers a gender pay gap measure; ext.financial.total_income is business income for a period, a different meaning, owner and units, so reuse would change meaning.
